methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Roanoke College partners with Google for free AI training - WDBJ7
signals.signal_reading: Google partnership with Roanoke College democratizes AI training access outside traditional tech hubs, creating potential for peer-to-peer skill distribution in underserved regions if training translates to local ecosystem development.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Norfolk native's grassroots free AI workshops explicitly target closing the technology gap, signaling distributed capability building through community-driven education rather than platform dependency or metro concentration.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: VCU-AI Ready RVA partnership concentrates institutional resources and expertise in Richmond metro, potentially deepening regional capability but raising questions about knowledge transfer to surrounding counties.

signals.title: Virginia Tech sets course for human-centered AI leadership - Virginia Tech News
signals.signal_reading: Virginia Tech's human-centered AI leadership initiative consolidates research capacity in established academic centers, reinforcing the university-as-hub model that could either radiate expertise outward or concentrate it in New River Valley.

signals.title: Camp Welcomes Hampton Roads Youth to Learn About Cybersecurity and AI - Old Dominion University
signals.signal_reading: ODU's youth cybersecurity and AI camp targets early-stage capability building in Hampton Roads, planting seeds for distributed fluency outside NoVA if participants become local multipliers rather than metro-bound talent.
